answer: Each identity posts one output with a 50-credit bond on the public canyon ledger for recount. Each genuine use adds a pigment mark, plume-signed by users. One funder cluster's uses add one mark together. At close, the bottom pigment quartile loses its bonds. The k-th fake output needs its own bond and marks, unpooled. 1,000 fakes bleed at least 250 bonds, 12,500 credits, each epoch, or pay 60,000 buying three uses each. A rented-use ring fails: its plume marks share one cluster, count once, and stay pale. An honest agent risks one bond, earns real pigment marks, and keeps full weight.
